title: Warm Buttery Dutch Red Bean Pilaf
description: A hearty and comforting Dutch dish featuring anko red bean paste, perfect for a post-workout meal. This pilaf is buttery, pillowy, and FODMAP-friendly.
instructions: Rinse the rice in a fine mesh strainer until the water runs clear.
In a large saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat.
Add the rice to the saucepan and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes.
Add the water, salt, and black pepper to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan, and simmer for 18 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the red bean paste to the small saucepan and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes.
Fluff the cooked rice with a fork and stir in the cooked red bean paste, chopped scallions, and lemon juice.
Serve the pilaf hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
